title: Pauli Contextuality Lab: Unified Lean 4.35.0 Formalization of Spectral Bounds, Disjoint Mermin Configurations, and Sequential Contextuality Evidence
peer_review_status: Consolidated research preprint suite (not peer reviewed; AI-assisted under human direction; 6-kernel Lean 4.35.0 & cross-platform CI verified)
author: Alexander Stephen Donahue

lean_verification.framework: Lean 4.35.0 / Mathlib v4.35.0 (160 explicit #print axioms + exhaustive 2,206-theorem Lean.collectAxioms audit across HoggarBound, ContextualityTensor, Evidence, PauliContextualityLab; 0 Batteries linter errors; 12 headline targets verified across 6 independent kernels via lake comparator --paranoid in Ubuntu 24.04 CI)

core_result: Consolidates the four archived Pauli/Mermin contextuality repositories (hoggar-bound, hoggar-bound-lab, contextuality-tensor-lab, contextuality-evidence-lab) into one unified Apache-2.0 / CC-BY-4.0 monorepo meeting Build Standard v1.2.0 (100.0%, 68/68 checks, Core 30/30, 10 finding classes, Draft 2020-12 JSON Schema-validated repo.yaml) and Defensible Independent AI Research Playbook v1.3 (ERRATA.md, CRediT & COI disclosures across all 4 manuscripts, 1,900-problem Unsolved Problems Mega-Atlas V2 cross-reference in docs/mega-atlas-cross-reference.md honestly recording 0/1,900 grand problems solved with bounded QM-011 finite-dimensional Pauli subcases settled in Lean 4.35.0, BibTeX + Handle + Crossref retraction-free citation audit across 44/44 URLs and 17/17 journal DOIs, cross-track adversarial false-variant Lean rejection tests, repo-wide CDN sha384 SRI guard, and SHA-256-verified gitleaks v8.30.1 + osv-scanner v2.7.1 CI). Ships a single pinned Lean 4.35.0 + Mathlib v4.35.0 workspace (transparent 60-module audit map in lean/README.md), deduplicated third-party stack, searchable 27-node / 162-declaration Lean Blueprint (/blueprint/) with MathJax SRI, explicit Sp(2N,2) witness isomorphism verifier plus Qontextium-ready hyperbolic quasi-quadric (135/1,095/75) exports (/exports/hyperbolic-quasi-quadric-135/), 4 zero-overflow Tectonic PDFs (literal 0.00pt max overfull hbox across all 4 PDFs), and 3-OS + 14-engine zero-warning C11 ASan/UBSan CI (run 45741807429). Track 1 proves the universal spectral floor, Kramers floor, 5-way saturation equivalences, exact degrees (75, 480, 2016, 729344), infinite non-closed pure-CCZ determinant family |Psi_{3m}>, unconditional N=4..5 bounds d(W(7,2))>=1455 and d(Q+(9,2))>=6444, exact four-qubit C3 binary completion optima (368 vs 344, gap 24), and Jonah's Conjecture E across all 9 vertex cases for every N>=4. Track 2 proves exact arbitrary-k disjoint-copy formulas d_k=(7^k-5^k)/2 (squares) and (6^k-4^k)/2 (pentagrams) addressing Muller & Saniga (arXiv:2609.19862v1 Sec. 6). Track 3 proves finite adaptive-tree sequential evidence bounds and a sharp setting-bias attack on the Peres-Mermin square. Live Ubuntu CI run 45741807525 audited 160 explicit #print axioms and all 2,206 theorems strictly within standard axioms, refuted 3 cross-track adversarial false-variant Lean theorems, and verified all 12 cross-track comparator targets across all 6 independent kernels (lean-paranoid, lean4lean, nanoda, con-leche, con-ron, lean-default) with Sigstore/Rekor attestation (Lean logIndex 4116592110; Release v2.9.0 run 45744521481 Rekor logIndex 4116605402).
verification_boundary: 160 explicit headline declarations plus an exhaustive 2,206-theorem Lean.collectAxioms audit in VerifyAll.lean (zero sorry, zero native_decide, zero warnings, strictly within [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]), 3 cross-track adversarial false-variant Lean rejection checks, and 12 cross-track Challenge/Solution targets are machine-checked in Lean 4.35.0 across 6 independent kernels in CI; 51 pytest suites (+6 subtests, including repo-wide CDN sha384 SRI guard, Draft 2020-12 repo.yaml schema, 10-class labels, _native.* axiom-rejection & Palomar size guards, Sp(2N,2) witness isomorphism & Qontextium export tests, property, negative, 6-mutant killing, 300-payload fuzz, live C3/Blueprint/explorer/monorepo integrity), 2 Node web-model tests, 7 track exact verifiers, and 14 zero-warning C11 ASan/UBSan engines pass across Linux/macOS/Windows CI. Finite C censuses (540.3M N=9 forms, 42-orbit W(5,2) census), Moonlab/QGTL/QRNG simulations, and exploratory floating-point scripts are explicitly separated from Lean kernel proofs (see CLAIMS.md, LIMITATIONS.md, ERRATA.md, and docs/statement-fidelity.md). No external peer review, hardware experiment, or external DOI is claimed.
